description: Where the pilot stands on a day, from the logbook and the dates they give: passengers by day (14 CFR 61.57(a)) and at night (61.57(b)), the flight review (61.56(c)), the medical, the logbook's totals and instrument currency (61.57(c)(1), (d)). The gateway's CurrencyDto.

medical_expires_on.description: The day the medical expires, as the pilot gives it, YYYY-MM-DD.

ipc_on.description: The last instrument proficiency check (61.57(d)), YYYY-MM-DD.

flying.description: The airplane to be flown, for passenger currency (14 CFR 61.57(a)(1)(ii): "if the aircraft to be flown is an airplane with a tailwheel"): its category and class, and whether it has a tailwheel (null: not said, judged as one). Null: the newest flight's.

dayPassengersUntil.description: 90 days after the third most recent landing the logbook proves counts for the airplane judged (61.57(a)(1)): in its category and class, and in a tailwheel to a full stop; null with fewer than three. Never a guess: see dayPassengersUnknown.

nightPassengersUntil.description: 90 days after the third most recent night full-stop landing the logbook proves counts for the airplane judged (61.57(b)(1)).

passengerClass.description: The category and class passenger currency was judged in, "airplane/single-engine land": the airplane to be flown's (flying), else the newest flight's (61.57(a)(1)); null where neither says.

passengerClassUnknown.description: No category and class to judge in: neither the airplane to be flown nor the newest flight says it, so no landing is counted (61.57(a)(1)).

passengerTailwheel.description: Whether the airplane judged has a tailwheel; null where the airplane to be flown doesn't say, judged as one, the stricter (61.57(a)(1)(ii)).

tailwheelPassengersUntil.description: For a pilot judged in a tricycle whose logbook shows a tailwheel in the same class: the tailwheel's own, 90 days after the third most recent full-stop landing in one (61.57(a)(1)(ii)); else null.

dayPassengersUnknown.description: What the logbook doesn't say, where the pilot would be current by day (61.57(a)(1)) if it were so, in a sentence beginning "Can't tell"; null where nothing unsaid matters.

flightReviewOn.description: YYYY-MM-DD; null where none can be had.

flightReviewUntil.description: The end of the 24th calendar month after the flight review's (61.56(c)).

medicalExpiresOn.description: YYYY-MM-DD; null where none can be had.

totalHours.description: Every entry's hours, to the tenth.

instrumentCurrentUntil.description: The last day of instrument currency (61.57(c)(1), or 61.57(d)'s check); in the past where it has lapsed, null where none is logged.

instrumentCurrentFrom.description: The first day of an instrument currency not begun yet: approaches, holding and tracking flown this month count from the first of next month (61.57(c)(1), 'the 6 calendar months preceding the month of the flight'), so until then the pilot is not current and instrumentCurrentUntil is the end of the currency to come. Null when current now, lapsed or none logged.

ipcOn.description: YYYY-MM-DD; null where none can be had.

ipcNeededAfter.description: The day after which only an instrument proficiency check restores it: six calendar months past instrumentCurrentUntil (61.57(d)).

approachesInWindow.description: Approaches logged in the 6 calendar months before this one (61.57(c)(1)(i)).

trackingInWindow.description: Intercepting and tracking courses logged in them (61.57(c)(1)(iii)).

due.description: What falls due, each named and cited: the flight review (61.56(c)), the medical (61.23), passengers by day and at night (61.57(a), (b)), instrument currency (61.57(c)), each where it can be had.
